name: tcb-span
description: Implementation of C++20's std::span for older compilers (overlay: the same upstream commit as the vcpkg baseline, plus the no-exceptions include fix that LIEF 1.0.0's tree carries).

Why an overlay exists: LIEF 1.0.0 builds its core library with exceptions disabled (LIEF_DISABLE_EXCEPTIONS defaults ON), which activates span's TCB_SPAN_NO_EXCEPTIONS branch. That branch calls std::terminate(), but the upstream header only includes <exception> for it in a commit (b70b0ff) that is not reachable from any ref in tcbrindle/span - it exists solely inside LIEF's vendored copy. The baseline's 2022-06-15 snapshot lacks the include, so LIEF 1.0.0 would fail to compile against it. The overlay applies that two-line fix to the same upstream commit the baseline pins. port-version 1 records that this is the baseline's snapshot plus a patch, not a newer upstream snapshot.
